title: NLEBench+NorGLM: A Comprehensive Empirical Analysis and Benchmark Dataset for Generative Language Models in Norwegian
benchmark_measurement: Perplexity-based stereotype and bias detection in the context of religion, by comparing scores between stereotype and anti-stereotype sentence pairs.
findings: The models exhibited a bias towards the anti-stereotype sentence (sent_less) in the religion category, suggesting a relative bias against public stereotypes in this specific context.
